package internalapi

import (
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	handlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

// Handler is the private contour dependency set.
type Handler = handlers.Handler

var NewHandler = handlers.NewHandler

// NewRouter creates internal router with token protection.
func NewRouter(handler *handlers.Handler, token string, dedicatedTokens ...string) chi.Router {
	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Group(func(trusted chi.Router) {
		trusted.Use(middleware.RequireInternalToken(token))
		trusted.Get("/answers/{answerID}/status", handler.GetAnswerStatus)
		trusted.Get("/answers/progress", handler.GetTaskProgress)
		trusted.Get("/practice-tasks/{id}/usage", handler.GetPracticeTaskUsage)
		trusted.Get("/practice-task-parts/{id}/usage", handler.GetPracticeTaskPartUsage)
		trusted.Get("/practice-task-milestones/{id}/usage", handler.GetPracticeTaskMilestoneUsage)
		trusted.Get("/students/{studentID}/learning-actions/{learningActionID}/context", handler.GetLearningActionContext)
		trusted.Get("/students/{studentID}/learning-actions/{learningActionID}/code-context", handler.GetLearningActionCodeContext)
		trusted.Post("/students/{studentID}/mastery/query", handler.QueryStudentTargetMastery)
		trusted.Post("/students/{studentID}/practice-evidence", handler.ApplyPracticeEvidence)
		trusted.Get("/students/{studentID}/learner-overview", handler.GetLearnerOverview)
		trusted.Get("/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/items/{itemID}/lesson-context", handler.GetAssignedLessonContext)
		trusted.Get("/students/{studentID}/planning-readiness", handler.GetStudentPlanningReadiness)
		trusted.Post("/students/{studentID}/diagnostics/snapshots", handler.CaptureDiagnosticSnapshot)
		trusted.Get("/students/{studentID}/learning-sessions/{sessionID}", handler.GetLearningSession)
		trusted.Put("/students/{studentID}/learning-sessions/{sessionID}/metrics", handler.ApplyLearningSessionMetrics)
	})
	if len(dedicatedTokens) > 0 && dedicatedTokens[0] != "" &&
		(handler.CourseAssignments != nil || handler.LearningPaths != nil || handler.LearningPathCompletion != nil || handler.OnboardingPathAdmissions != nil || handler.DiagnosticAssessments != nil ||
			handler.LearningPathPlanning != nil || handler.PlanningSnapshot != nil || handler.HybridApplication != nil) {
		r.Group(func(planner chi.Router) {
			planner.Use(middleware.RequireInternalToken(dedicatedTokens[0]))
			planner.Put("/students/{studentID}/courses/{courseID}/assignment", handler.AssignCourse)
			planner.Put("/students/{studentID}/learning-path", handler.ReplaceLearningPath)
			planner.Put("/students/{studentID}/learning-path/completion", handler.CompleteLearningPath)
			planner.Get("/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/planning-state", handler.GetLearningPathPlanningState)
			planner.Put("/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}", handler.ReplanLearningPath)
			planner.Put("/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/completion", handler.CompleteExactLearningPath)
			if handler.PlanningSnapshot != nil {
				planner.Post("/v1/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/planning-snapshot", handler.GetPlanningSnapshot)
			}
			if handler.HybridApplication != nil {
				planner.Post("/v1/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/hybrid-consequences", handler.ApplyHybridConsequence)
			}
			if handler.OnboardingPathAdmissions != nil {
				planner.Post("/students/{studentID}/onboarding-path-admissions", handler.ReserveOnboardingPathAdmission)
				planner.Post("/students/{studentID}/onboarding-path-admissions/{admissionID}/renewal", handler.RenewOnboardingPathAdmission)
				planner.Put("/students/{studentID}/onboarding-path-admissions/{admissionID}/materialization", handler.MaterializeOnboardingPathAdmission)
				planner.Post("/students/{studentID}/onboarding-path-admissions/{admissionID}/abort", handler.AbortOnboardingPathAdmission)
			}
			if handler.DiagnosticAssessments != nil {
				planner.Post("/v1/students/{studentID}/diagnostic-assessments/{planID}/reserve", handler.ReserveDiagnosticAssessment)
				planner.Get("/v1/students/{studentID}/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/result", handler.GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult)
			}
		})
	}
	if len(dedicatedTokens) > 1 && dedicatedTokens[1] != "" &&
		(handler.OnboardingDrafts != nil || handler.OnboardingDraftWrites != nil ||
			handler.OnboardingFinalization != nil || handler.OnboardingProfiles != nil || handler.OnboardingTurnApply != nil ||
			handler.OnboardingTurns != nil || handler.OnboardingTurnProofs != nil || handler.LearningWorkspace != nil || handler.NextAction != nil) {
		r.Group(func(teacher chi.Router) {
			teacher.Use(middleware.RequireInternalToken(dedicatedTokens[1]))
			if handler.NextAction != nil {
				teacher.Get("/students/{studentID}/next-action", handler.GetNextAction)
			}
			if handler.LearningWorkspace != nil {
				teacher.Get("/students/{studentID}/learning-workspace", handler.GetLearningWorkspace)
			}
			if handler.OnboardingDrafts != nil && handler.OnboardingProfiles != nil {
				teacher.Get("/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/draft", handler.GetTeacherStudentOnboardingState)
			}
			if handler.OnboardingDraftWrites != nil {
				teacher.Put("/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/draft", handler.PutTeacherStudentOnboardingDraft)
			}
			if handler.OnboardingFinalization != nil {
				teacher.Post("/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/draft/finalize", handler.FinalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingDraft)
			}
			if handler.OnboardingTurnApply != nil && handler.OnboardingTurns != nil && handler.OnboardingTurnProofs != nil {
				teacher.Post("/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns", handler.ApplyTeacherStudentOnboardingTurn)
				teacher.Get("/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns/{studentCommandID}", handler.GetTeacherStudentOnboardingTurn)
				teacher.Post("/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns/{studentCommandID}/prove-no-effect", handler.ProveTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffect)
			}
		})
	}
	if len(dedicatedTokens) > 2 && dedicatedTokens[2] != "" && (handler.PracticeLearningActions != nil || handler.PracticeLearningEvidence != nil) {
		r.Group(func(practice chi.Router) {
			practice.Use(middleware.RequireInternalToken(dedicatedTokens[2]))
			if handler.PracticeLearningActions != nil {
				practice.Put("/v2/students/{studentID}/practice-learning-actions/{taskInstanceID}", handler.ReservePracticeLearningAction)
				practice.Get("/v2/students/{studentID}/practice-learning-actions/{taskInstanceID}", handler.GetPracticeLearningAction)
				practice.Post("/v2/students/{studentID}/practice-learning-actions/{taskInstanceID}/open", handler.OpenPracticeLearningAction)
				practice.Post("/v2/students/{studentID}/practice-learning-actions/{taskInstanceID}/cancel", handler.CancelPracticeLearningAction)
			}
			if handler.PracticeLearningEvidence != nil {
				practice.Post("/v2/students/{studentID}/practice-learning-actions/{taskInstanceID}/evidence", handler.ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence)
			}
		})
	}
	return r
}
